ACHERON-CRIMSON_UMBRELLA_ACHERON.title: Crimson Umbrella
ACHERON-CRIMSON_UMBRELLA_ACHERON.descrip:
At combat start, gain 3 [gold]Slashed Dream[/gold].
Every 5 [gold]Crimson Knot[/gold] you apply, gain 1 [gold]Slashed Dream[/gold].
[color=purple]Eidolon System[/color].
ACHERON-BLADE_OF_MYRIAD_ACHERON.title: Higanbana Hairpin
ACHERON-BLADE_OF_MYRIAD_ACHERON.descript:
At combat start, gain 4 [gold]Slashed Dream[/gold] and apply 3 [gold]Crimson Knot[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Every 4 [gold]Crimson Knot[/gold] applied, gain 1 [gold]Slashed Dream[/gold].
[color=purple]Eidolon System[/color].
ACHERON-EIDOLON_E1_ACHERON.title: E1: Thunder Judgment
ACHERON-EIDOLON_E1_ACHERON.description: Deal 20% more damage to enemies with [gold]Crimson Knot[/gold].
ACHERON-EIDOLON_E2_ACHERON.title: E2: Abyssal Pull
ACHERON-EIDOLON_E2_ACHERON.description: At the start of your turn, gain 1 [gold]Slashed Dream[/gold]. Apply 1 [gold]Crimson Knot[/gold] to the enemy with the most [gold]Crimson Knot[/gold].
ACHERON-EIDOLON_E3_ACHERON.title: E3: Final Edge
ACHERON-EIDOLON_E3_ACHERON.description: Your [gold]Guidance[/gold] trigger chance is increased by 10%.
ACHERON-EIDOLON_E4_ACHERON.title: E4: Karmic Omen
ACHERON-EIDOLON_E4_ACHERON.description: At combat start, all enemies gain 2 [gold]Crimson Knot[/gold] and 1 Vulnerable.
ACHERON-EIDOLON_E5_ACHERON.title: E5: Tear Mark
ACHERON-EIDOLON_E5_ACHERON.description: Your Final Strike cards deal 4 more damage.
ACHERON-EIDOLON_E6_ACHERON.title: E6: Nihility's End
ACHERON-EIDOLON_E6_ACHERON.description: All Attack cards deal additional damage equal to your current [gold]Slashed Dream[/gold] stacks.
ACHERON-ENTWINED_CRIMSON_VINE_ACHERON.de: Whenever you apply [gold]Crimson Knot[/gold], gain [blue]Block[/blue] equal to the stacks applied.
ACHERON-WANGCHUAN_BELL_ACHERON.title: Wangchuan Bell
ACHERON-WANGCHUAN_BELL_ACHERON.descripti: Whenever one of your cards triggers [gold]Astray[/gold], gain 1 [gold]Slashed Dream[/gold].
ACHERON-FORKING_LANTERN_ACHERON.title: Forking Lantern
ACHERON-FORKING_LANTERN_ACHERON.descript: Your [gold]Astray[/gold] trigger chance is increased by 25%.
Whenever you play a card originally from another character's card pool, draw 1 card.
ACHERON-PHANTOM_FOAM_BELL_ACHERON.title: Phantom Foam Bell
ACHERON-PHANTOM_FOAM_BELL_ACHERON.descri: Your [gold]Guidance[/gold] trigger chance is increased by 8%.
ACHERON-HUANGQUAN_RETURN_TSUBA_ACHERON.d: Whenever you play [gold]Draw Sword[/gold], gain 3 [gold]Slashed Dream[/gold].
